purpose: One bounded clock-512 diagnostic over the immutable N384/M384 baseline state, using a 768^3 unshifted physical lattice to measure analytical-reference errors for full velocity, ordered gradient and ordered Hessian globally and in every existing sampled spatial class.

source_bindings.binding_policy: Before any implementation run, hash every listed path at the reviewed implementation commit, add the new adapter and executable hashes, and refuse any mismatch. The case hash is a semantic case binding, while every entry below is a byte-level source binding for this plan.

files.role: velocity, gradient, ordered Hessian and vorticity reference evaluation
exclusive point classification and startup phase
spectral derivative staging, catalog-backed AVX construction and sampling
explicit preflight, pilot and reviewed execute command boundary
packed 30-word reference and ordered-Hessian equality check
single-snapshot binding, admission, immutable sampling, reductions and transactional output

immutable_snapshot.access: bounded streaming decode to owned coefficient vectors followed only by immutable borrows; no runtime state constructor, import, resume, injection or evolution interface
immutable_snapshot.integrity: validate manifest, plan, file, coefficient, clock, profile and source before allocation; rehash borrowed coefficients after all measurements and require the same coefficient SHA-256

diagnostic_policy.reference_worker_partition: 32 disjoint groups of 24 complete x-planes; each point is evaluated once
diagnostic_policy.relative_floor_rule: For each quantity, max(fixed positive absolute_floor, 1e-3 * analytical reference_peak) is computed from the already complete immutable reference cache before any error reduction.
diagnostic_policy.hessian_order: velocity component, first derivative axis, second derivative axis; both mixed ordered entries are emitted and counted
diagnostic_policy.packed_reference_layout: 30 binary64 words per point: velocity[3], gradient component-major[9], then six symmetric Hessian entries xx,xy,xz,yy,yz,zz for each velocity component[18]; ordered mixed Hessian entries are expanded twice from the same canonical jet coefficient
diagnostic_policy.publication: one transactional JSON candidate promoted only after complete validation, all three global reports, all 15 quantity-by-class regional entries, core/annulus coverage reports, post-measurement coefficient hash and output validation

required_output.global_physical_row_meaning: three quantities times RMS error, sampled absolute peak and sampled relative peak
required_output.regional_row_meaning: five exclusive sampled masks times three quantities times RMS error, sampled absolute peak and sampled relative peak
additional_fields: sample count and NoSamples status for each class
reference peak and exact relative floor for every global and regional report
one common five-class count vector, which must sum to 452984832
three-panel-refinement RegionCoverage records for nominal core and annulus
all snapshot, plan, source, evaluator, diagnostic-binary and diagnostic-policy hashes
complete admitted and charged work ledgers

execution_sequence: Read and validate the single reviewed snapshot manifest and its frozen plan without exposing an evolving-state constructor.
Preflight exact storage and work with checked integer arithmetic; refuse unless CAP_BYTES equals the admitted reservation and the external memory/wall admission gates pass.
Stream-decode and hash the snapshot into three owned coefficient vectors; thereafter expose only immutable slices.
In 32 disjoint deterministic x-plane shards, call fields::reference::evaluate once per point, pack 30 unique reference values, call regions::classify once per point and store one u8 class label.
Measure velocity, gradient and ordered Hessian sequentially with one reusable AVX derivative workspace; reuse two pointwise magnitude arrays between quantities.
For each completed quantity, reduce the same magnitudes into one global and five exclusive sampled-class TensorErrors reports before clearing scratch.
Evaluate nominal core and annulus CoveragePlan refinements at panels 256, 512 and 1024, keeping sampled counts separate from physical-volume coverage.
Rehash the immutable coefficient slices, validate the complete result, fsync a candidate, rename it atomically and emit hashes/provenance.

reusable_code.use: bounded P10AVXSNAP1 length/header/clock/hash decode; use the external-reference admission path because it binds the reviewed N384 profile
exact source/profile/schedule/clock/cap allowlist for the clock-512 N384/M384 state
strict-band ik differentiation, zero padding, self-conjugate-plane projection and complete inverse sampling without changing input spectra
canonical component counts, ordered derivative schedule and curl orientation; its sampling method is not currently public to a harness
one binary64 analytical velocity/gradient/ordered-Hessian/vorticity evaluation per physical point
exact existing spherical/core/annulus/collar/exterior partition and separate startup label
unchanged complete-field RMS, peak, relative-peak and NoSamples semantics
output semantics and negative controls; its current API reclassifies every point and therefore is not the execution owner for the cached-label adapter
existing separately refined one-dimensional nominal-volume intersection measurements
behavioral template proving global and regional reducers consume identical pointwise magnitudes; the six-family owner and schedule are not reusable
already reviewed allocation-free spectral ordered-Hessian norm and manifest-output pattern; it is global spectral evidence only and cannot replace the pointwise regional path

implemented_adapter_glue: An exact one-snapshot binding accepts only the reviewed N384/M384 clock-512 manifest and refuses any different source, plan, coefficient, profile, case, schedule or clock identity.
DerivativeWorkspace exposes catalog-backed AVX reservation and construction while retaining the existing strict-band staging, normalization and self-conjugate-plane projection.
A fixed 30-word cache packs velocity, gradient and 18 canonical symmetric-Hessian words; every insertion compares the expansion bitwise with all 27 independently evaluated ordered entries.
SpatialRegion is classified once per sample and cached as a u8 label; global and five-class TensorErrors reducers consume the same two magnitude arrays.

The snapshot-specific report preserves no-sample states, sampled collar counts/errors, core/annulus coverage, no-acceptance status, the exact storage/work ledgers and a post-measurement coefficient rehash. Its bounded candidate is synced and atomically renamed.
remaining_out_of_scope_glue: A reviewed cutoff-collar physical-volume coverage consumer. Current CoveragePlan implements nominal core and annulus only; sampled Collar errors and counts must not be described as collar volume coverage.

A reviewed sampled-peak qualification adapter, including location and a tie rule, if a later artifact is intended to satisfy the design's concentration rows. This bounded diagnostic reports sampled peak values but makes no peak qualification claim.

A root-reviewed full-run build binding the final implementation commit and release executable hash. The execute gate verifies the supplied running-binary hash, but no full-run binary has been approved or launched.
storage_notes: The derivative-workspace figure uses the measured 768^3 AVX shared-plan reservation 3633389976 bytes plus a 227082240-element Complex64 staging buffer, a 452984832-element f64 value buffer and the compiled 408-byte object size.
The 30-word cache relies on Hessian mixed-partial symmetry but expands both ordered mixed entries during reduction; no component is omitted from the reported Frobenius magnitude.
The cap excludes the immutable state file on disk and output candidate on disk; both have separate filesystem capacity checks.

work_reservation.fft_internal_work: bounded by the selected immutable 768^3 AVX plan but not represented as primitive FLOPs

forecast_basis: The completed scalar external-reference bridge evaluated 452984832 points and three 768^3 forward FFTs in 119.99 seconds at 19.44 GiB measured RSS.
Completed positive-node doubled-grid observer work required 271.5 to 296.7 seconds per node under the campaign profile.

The complete x=0 plane pilot evaluated and checked 589824 packed references in 35.543683109 seconds and classified them in 0.044999717 seconds. Linear scaling gives 27332.108825088 seconds sequential and 853.048394616 seconds under ideal 32-worker reference scaling, before the 39 inverse transforms and reductions.
The forecast remains a review envelope because the pilot does not measure 32-worker scaling, full-grid memory bandwidth, 39 transforms or reductions together.
admission: Run only after active trajectory and residual/reference jobs release the host.
Require MemAvailable >= admitted_total + 16 GiB immediately before launch.
Apply an address-space limit of 128 GiB, timeout TERM at 2400 seconds with a 60-second kill-after, fixed 32-worker x-plane partition and an explicit output/disk cap.
Treat timeout, allocation refusal, nonzero exit, hash mismatch, incomplete grid, missing class metadata or a missing required output field as no diagnostic publication.

root_full_run_review: Confirm residual localization and every other campaign workload are idle.
Confirm MemAvailable is at least 145951239256 bytes and at least 32 CPUs fit the host allocation.
Review the final source commit and release executable SHA-256, then supply the explicit execution gates documented in the runbook.
Apply an external 128771370072-byte address-space limit and a 2400-second TERM timeout with a 60-second kill-after.

Keep sampled collar results, sampled peak values, binary64 reference arithmetic and the single 768^3 lattice labeled as diagnostic measurements without collar-volume, peak, reference-precision or sampling-convergence qualification.
